agency_app.purpose: Agency-level control for CloudSales, including agency resources exposed by HighLevel such as snapshots and future Agency Pro capabilities.
agency_app.status: existing app renamed/configured in Developer Portal

location_app.purpose: Primary CloudSales integration used by Cloudy and AgentCloud to operate each customer Location/Sub-Account.

architecture.control_model: CloudSales is the user-facing product. HighLevel remains a connected provider behind CloudSales. Cloudy and AgentCloud select the correct Agency or Location authorization according to the requested action.

backend.required_follow_up: Align the deployed OAuth callback/credential redirect URI with https://cloudsales.app/oauth/callback and validate state before production Marketplace install testing.

location_scope_strategy.principle: Request read and write access for operational modules Cloudy/AgentCloud are expected to manage; avoid unrelated destructive or agency-administrative permissions.
location_scope_strategy.note: Exact scope identifiers must be selected from the Sub-Account scope list in the HighLevel Developer Portal; do not invent identifiers.

priority_modules: phone system/Twilio resources where available and justified

billing.dynamic_pricing_rule: CloudSales charges from actual landed provider cost whenever available. Basic = landed cost x1.50, Pro = landed cost x1.35, Premium = landed cost x1.25. Domains = landed cost x2. Dynamic country, carrier, model, TTS and provider fees are incorporated when applicable. HighLevel default meter values are fallback values only; unknown provider cost is reconciled rather than guessed.
